title: Checkout feature flag causes N+1 query storm
alert: Customers report the shop feels sluggish; product pages take 5-10 seconds to load since around 10 AM.

truth.root_cause: The api 2.3.1 deploy added a checkout_v2 feature flag. When enabled this morning, its product list query runs a separate SELECT per product (N+1), overwhelming the database.
truth.fix: Roll back api to 2.3.0 to remove the buggy feature flag code, then verify product pages are fast again. Long term: fix the N+1 query in 2.3.1 and re-enable the flag.
